title: Assign a different mobile site template to a store, display or zone
summary: Give a store its own mobile site template, or assign a template to the displays in a zone so the menu changes with the visitor's location.
bodyMd:
Different stores, and different zones inside a store, can show different menus. Assign a template to a store to change what visitors see from that store's QR code, or assign a template to the displays in a zone to change what visitors see when they scan a display there.

Before you begin

  • The template you want to assign exists. See Create a mobile site template for a concierge kiosk for how to create one.
  • For a display, QR Control is enabled on the platform. See Enable QR Control and set the default QR code settings.

Assign a template to a store

  1. In the left navigation, select Stores / Branches.
  2. Select the store's name, for example Sydney CBD.
  3. On the Store Details tab, in QR Control - Mobile Site Template, choose the template.
  4. Select Save Changes.

Assign a template to a display or zone

A zone is a set of displays. Repeat these steps for each display in the zone.

  1. In the left navigation, select Displays & Devices.
  2. Select the display's name, for example Landscape-Single 2.
  3. If you want the name to reflect the zone, on the Display Details tab change Display Name to something like Store Entrance, then select Save Changes.
  4. Select the Enabled Features tab.
  5. Tick Enable QR Control, if it is not already ticked.
  6. In QR Control - Mobile Site Template, choose the template.
  7. Select Save Changes.

Verify it worked

The QR Control - Mobile Site Template field shows the new template after the page reloads. Scan the store's QR code or the display's QR code on a phone: the site shows the new template's header and menu items.
